derivation: Every valid and produced vector is the byte output of the real `ocm prepare`, `ocm link`, and `ocm mark` producers over the deterministic seed universe in universe.go; producer_test.go re-derives them on every run. Every hostile vector is one minimal edit of a produced map, and every fixture case is one perturbation of a produced map, with the refusal code read off the wire profile's failure-code table. A drift in any frozen byte or code is a wire change and is recorded in the OCM spec before the data is refrozen (OCM-V0-014).

coverage.clause: Wire profile: valid minimal map (empty claims, every obligation unknown/unassessed)
Wire profile: disposition `linked` with reason `change-and-test-linked` and non-empty references
Wire profile: disposition `unknown` with empty references and each admitted reason
Wire profile: canonical JSON (sorted members, no insignificant whitespace, one terminal LF) and round-trip identity
Wire profile: closed object, all fields required, duplicate keys invalid
Wire profile: `spec` value, full target OID, CEM digests, non-empty spans
Wire profile: malformed JSON and non-object documents refuse with the fixed JSON failure profile
Wire profile: obligation IDs match the requirement regex and are unique
Wire profile: claims sorted and unique by content-derived ID; references well-formed
Wire profile: limits (1 MiB map, 256 obligations)
OCM-V0-004 / OCM-V0-005: references resolve to supported CEM hunks and present claims anchored on the exact obligation
OCM-V0-003: obligations equal the scope's requirement list in order
OCM-V0-002 / OCM-V0-006: CEM digest and target binding
